hints.title: Two Independent Target Characters
hints.text: The longest contiguous streak can either consist entirely of true answers or entirely of false answers.

hints.title: Dynamic Sliding Window
hints.text: For a target character c, expand window to the right and count occurrences of the opposite character.

hints.title: Window Contraction Condition
hints.text: Whenever the count of opposite characters exceeds k, advance the left pointer until opposite count is at most k.
